title: Router candidate collection rescans every coordination event file per candidate
description: Found during live container harness runs. python/src/kanbus/issue_router.py _collect_candidates calls _has_live_package_claim -> coordination.inspect_lease -> _load_coordination_events for each candidate, and each call globs and JSON-parses every file in project/events (544 files on the develop board). On a slow filesystem (a Docker Desktop bind mount) one scan took 1.5-3s and a single router plan needed many minutes, so a router run exceeded a 600s timeout without ever launching an agent. Even on a native disk this is O(candidates x events) and gets worse as the board grows. Load and index the coordination events once per plan (or per resource on demand with a cache) and confirm the Rust runtime does not have the same per-candidate rescan. Spec first: add a Gherkin scenario asserting the plan reads each event file at most once. Both runtimes must keep identical behavior.
